preconditions.description: Input n must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(numTrees(i) * numTrees(n - 1 - i) for i in range(n)) if n > 0 else 1
postconditions.description: For n > 0, the output is the sum over all possible left subtree sizes i (0 ≤ i < n) of the product of the number of unique BSTs for the left subtree (i nodes) and the number of unique BSTs for the right subtree (n-1-i nodes). For n = 0, the output is 1 (the empty tree).
